**Sqwt::UIElement uses MSVC multiple inheritance** with two vftables: PRIMARY at 0x0106C2A4 (object+0x00) and SECONDARY at 0x0106C3CC (object+0xB4). **RaptureElement and UIElement are SIBLING branches** sharing Sqwt::InputElement as their common deep base, NOT a UIElement-inherits-from-RaptureElement (or vice-versa) chain. Both BCS-Y-0539 (RaptureElement::ctor) and BCS-Y-1383 (UIElement::ctor) call FUN_0091E090 (InputElement::ctor) as their base ctor. RaptureElement is the Bahamut-side framework element; UIElement is the Sqwt-side base UI element.
